semantic_intent.not_exercised: No live-model semantic-intent scenario was included; all proposals were scripted.

coverage_limits: Single-process local gateway and sandbox only; cross-host coordination was not measured.
No live-model prompt injection or real financial execution was measured.
Audit fault injection, crash consistency, and deletion resistance were not measured by this frozen scenario set.
The trusted host's identity, grant issuance, clock, and approval authority were assumed correct.
